title: «Con licenza de’ Superiori»
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: The volume collects thirty-three essays honouring professor Mario Infelise. The variety of topics proposed by the authors shows the range and depth of the discussions that Mario Infelise’s work has provoked over the years: the history of books, printing and publishing, the history of information and censorship, and cultural history, always intertwined with the great history of the Modern Age.
